EnableFeedbackAndSupport.Description: Disable the OneDrive in-app feedback and support contact experience

PreventNetworkTrafficPreUserSignIn.Description: Prevent network traffic before user signs in

DisableOSUpgrade.Description: Block Store upgrade offers (Windows Update still works)

Description: Disables OneDrive feedback/sync-health reporting, delays OneDrive traffic until sign-in, and blocks Store OS-upgrade offers. Existing Personal OneDrive and Store-access policy is preserved rather than relaxed.
